**Northgate Clinic, January–June 2026**

The account appears under two IDs, so a lookup on one ID gives an incomplete picture. `accounts.csv` lists ACC-1042 "Northgate Clinic" through 2026-03-31. It lists ACC-1077 "Northgate Health Partners (formerly Northgate Clinic)" from 2026-04-01. I treated them as one entity. The only link between them is that name text, which I couldn't check against anything else.

**Billing**

| Month | ID | Plan | Volume | Amount | Per unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jan | 1042 | standard | 1,840 | $772.80 | $0.42 |
| Feb | 1042 | no row | | | |
| Mar | 1042 | enterprise-annual | 1,910 | $592.10 | $0.31 |
| Apr | 1077 | enterprise-annual | 1,120 | $347.20 | $0.31 |
| May | 1077 | enterprise-annual | 1,085 | $336.35 | $0.31 |
| Jun | none | no row | | | |

Total billed over the four billed months is $2,048.45.

**Dated changes**
- **February:** the contract status was `paused`. It was `active` in March.
- **2026-03-01:** the plan changed from standard to enterprise-annual.
- **From March:** the per-unit rate was $0.31 instead of $0.42.
- **2026-04-01:** the account was re-keyed to ACC-1077. Billed volume was 1,910 in March and 1,120 in April.

These are sequences, not explanations. I haven't attributed any change to another, including the April volume drop. That would take a separate investigation.

**Tickets (6 in total)**
- **ACC-1042:** 01-08 feature-request, 03-11 feature-request, 03-26 integration.
- **ACC-1077:** 04-01 billing-question, 04-04 billing-question, 05-25 outage-report.

There are no tickets in June.

**Data gaps**
- **February:** there is no billing row. The paused status matches that, but these files don't show whether a paused month is simply unbilled or the row was dropped.
- **June:** there are no billing, status or ticket records under either ID. The other three accounts all have June billing, so this isn't a general export gap. The contract-status file stops at May for every account, so June can't be checked against it. I can't tell whether June means no billing, a lapse or a missing export.
- **Tickets:** nothing in these files lets me read a quiet period as "no support activity".

**Worth following up**
- Confirm the 1042 to 1077 mapping with the account owner.
- Ask the billing owner for the February and June runs.

If you want the April volume drop or the June silence explained, I can hand either to a hypothesis-driven investigation. The records here have already been looked at, so confirming either would need new or independent data.

The log is at `work/exploration-log.md`. I ran the skill's record validator on it and it printed no findings. Its exit status wasn't captured, so a clean pass is an inference.
